about-school.label: About — about the school
about-school.title: About the school
about-school.body: Established in 1979 in the lush surroundings of HAL 3rd Stage, Bengaluru, the Indiranagar Cambridge School has stood as a beacon of progressive learning for over four decades. What began with just 7 students and 2 teachers in a modest rented space in Thippasandra has matured into a trusted co-educational institution nurturing well-rounded learners.

about-founder.label: About — the founder
about-founder.title: About the founder
about-founder.body:
In 1979, Mrs. Kasturi Shoury set out to create a school that offered quality English-medium education to the lower middle class. Starting with just seven curious students in a modest rented space in Thippasandra, her vision blended rigorous academics with the values of compassion and continuous self-improvement.

"We do not educate for examinations; we educate for life," she believed. Under her stewardship, the school moved to its current premises in 1986 and produced its first Class X batch in 1989 — embedding life skills, meditation, and holistic development into the heart of the campus.
about-founder.quote: Nurture the root, and the branches will reach the skies.

about-principal.label: About — the principal
about-principal.title: About the Principal
about-principal.subtitle: Director of Academics · M.Phil, MA, B.Ed
about-principal.body: Mrs. Shanthi Ravichandran leads academics at Indiranagar Cambridge School, guiding the teaching team across Nursery to Grade 10 under the Karnataka State Education Board. Her focus is a classroom where every child is supported to reach their own personal best.

about-people.label: About — our faculty (intro)
about-people.title: Our Faculty
about-people.body:
Our teachers are at the heart of our school. With dedication, care and a strong sense of responsibility, they guide every child to learn, grow and become confident individuals.

We believe in a supportive teacher–student relationship where knowledge, values and individual attention come together to create meaningful learning.
about-people.subtitle: Dedicated Teachers. Caring Mentors. Inspiring Learners.

about-vision.label: About — vision
about-vision.title: Our Vision
about-vision.body: To nurture confident, compassionate and responsible learners for a better future.

about-mission.label: About — mission
about-mission.title: Our Mission
about-mission.body: To provide a safe, happy and disciplined environment where every child learns, explores, develops skills and grows into a responsible individual.

about-awards.label: About — awards & honours (intro)
about-awards.title: Awards & Honours
about-awards.body:
At The Indiranagar Cambridge School, every achievement is a reflection of the dedication, hard work and commitment of our students, teachers and the entire school community.

Our awards and honours celebrate excellence in academics, co-curricular activities, sports, leadership and service. Each recognition inspires us to continue learning, improving and striving towards our motto — "Towards Perfection."
about-awards.subtitle: Celebrating achievements. Recognising effort. Inspiring excellence.

academics-intro.title: Academics
academics-intro.body: At Indiranagar Cambridge School, our carefully calibrated curriculum follows the Karnataka State Education Board (KSEEB) syllabus with English as the medium of instruction. We empower our students through active discovery, life skills, and holistic development from Nursery to Grade 10.

people.name: Mrs. Aruna Pradeep Kannan
people.bio:
Mrs. Aruna Pradeep Kannan is an experienced educationist and school leader with 20 years of professional experience, including a decade in the IT sector and over 10 years in education. She holds a Diploma in Computer Science Engineering (D.C.E.), B.E. in Information Science, and Nursery Teacher Training (N.T.T.), and is currently pursuing her B.Ed. from Bangalore University.

With a strong belief that education should nurture both academic excellence and emotional well-being, she is committed to creating a child-friendly, disciplined and dynamic learning environment. As Headmistress of The Indiranagar Cambridge School, she works towards empowering students to discover their potential, develop confidence and become responsible citizens of tomorrow.

Her educational philosophy is simple: every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed.

people.name: Tr. Pallavi
people.bio: Tr. Pallavi is a passionate Middle School Science Teacher with over 5 years of teaching experience and a Master's degree in Science Education. She specializes in making complex scientific concepts accessible, fun, and relevant to everyday life. Her interactive lessons focus on hands-on laboratory experiments, critical thinking, and collaborative projects, encouraging curiosity and active learning among students.

people.name: Tr. Sowmya S. Chandi
people.qual: M.A., B.A., B.Ed. in Hindi, N.T.T.
people.bio:
Tr. Sowmya S. Chandi is an experienced Hindi educator with over a decade of teaching experience across High School, Upper Primary and Pre-University levels. She has served as a Hindi Teacher and Lecturer at reputed institutions including Global P.U. College, Miranda English Medium School and Sree Cauvery School.

Her areas of expertise include Hindi language teaching, classroom management, storytelling and script writing. She also brings strong skills in leadership and problem-solving, along with a passion for music. A trained singer, she holds Gamaka Junior and Senior certifications.

Her commitment to language, creativity and holistic learning enables her to make Hindi education engaging and meaningful for students.

people.name: Tr. Shruthi H. C.
people.bio:
Mrs. Shruthi H. C. is a dedicated Kannada educator with 8 years of teaching experience and a strong passion for promoting the richness of the Kannada language. She encourages students to develop their skills in reading, writing and grammar while nurturing creativity and confidence.

She actively prepares students for Kannada language competitions, elocution, essay writing, storytelling and poetry activities. She also contributes to the academic development of students by creating worksheets, question papers, study materials and other learning resources.

Her involvement in school cultural programmes through Kannada speeches, poetry and anchoring reflects her enthusiasm for making language learning engaging, expressive and meaningful.

people.name: Tr. Meenakshi M.
people.bio:
Mrs. Meenakshi M. is an experienced Social Science educator with 30 years of teaching experience, with a strong commitment to academic excellence and effective classroom practices.

She has been honoured with the Active Teacher Award by Akhil Bharatiya Nagrik Vikas Kendra and has actively participated in the 321 Ignite Programme and ELN practical classroom teaching initiatives.

She received a Certificate for Exemplary Performance for the academic year 2016–17 at SCET School. With her rich experience and leadership abilities, she has also served as a Middle School and High School Coordinator, contributing to academic planning, teacher support and student development.

Her dedication, experience and leadership make her a valuable member of the academic team at The Indiranagar Cambridge School.

people.name: Mrs. Veena Raj
people.qual: B.A. Psychology, B.Ed. (EVS), N.T.T., Diploma in Fashion Technology; M.A. Psychology (pursuing)
people.bio:
Mrs. Veena Raj is a dedicated educator and student counsellor with experience in teaching, child psychology, counselling and behavioural therapy. She has worked across pre-primary, primary and secondary levels, teaching subjects including Social Science, EVS and Kannada.

Her expertise includes student counselling, behavioural therapy, classroom management, child psychology, art and craft, and dance. She has a special interest in supporting young learners and helping children navigate behavioural and emotional challenges.

Her compassionate approach and experience in working with early learners enable her to provide individualised guidance and counselling support, contributing to a safe, nurturing and positive learning environment at The Indiranagar Cambridge School.

people.name: Tr. Nirmala Vinoth
people.qual: M.Sc. IT, B.Ed., M.C.S., B.Sc. Mathematics
people.bio:
Mrs. Nirmala Vinoth is a dedicated Mathematics educator with experience in Middle School teaching and class management. She promotes a student-centred approach with emphasis on conceptual understanding, problem-solving and activity-based learning.

She actively integrates technology and innovative teaching methods to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.

Area of Expertise: Middle School Mathematics – Grades 7 & 8.

people.name: Tr. Jayalakshmi
people.bio: Tr. Jayalakshmi is an enthusiastic high school Kannada teacher with over 6 years of teaching experience, dedicated to cultivating a deep love for the language, literature and cultural heritage of Karnataka. She specialises in translating classical and modern Kannada literature into relatable concepts, helping students easily grasp complex poetry and prose.

stages.title: Early Years Foundation
stages.alt: Early years students in the classroom
stages.text: Our Play-based learning curriculum focuses on cognitive, sensory, and motor development. By engaging in thematic story-circles, structured outdoor games, and interactive digital sandboxes, children build crucial confidence and language foundations.

cards.title: Sensory Play
cards.text: Interactive texture modules and rhythm training.

cards.title: Pre-Numeracy
cards.text: Play-based math concepts and letter shapes.

stages.title: Primary Academy
stages.alt: Primary students in animal masks for a classroom activity
stages.text: We introduce students to an inquiry-led pathway through the Karnataka State Education Board syllabus that triggers independent thinking. Math, Science, and Social Studies are presented through hands-on collaborative activities, instilling lifelong research habits and robust literacy.

cards.title: Core Literacy
cards.text: Bilingual immersion and basic scientific models.

cards.title: Problem Solving
cards.text: Introductory robotics and critical text analysis.

stages.title: Middle School
stages.alt: Middle school students working at their desks
stages.text: Transitioning towards formal scientific principles, analytical arithmetic, and deep historical insights. Middle school prepares students with dedicated physics, chemistry and biology laboratories, computer lab sessions, and structured public speaking training.

cards.title: Lab Sciences
cards.text: Formal physics, chemistry, and biology lab modules.

cards.title: Civic Leadership
cards.text: Historical analysis and youth parliament mock sessions.

stages.title: High School
stages.alt: High school students with their teachers
stages.text: Focused strictly on comprehensive board-exam alignment alongside holistic global mentorship. We maintain premium standards of counseling, supporting admissions to world-class higher secondary institutions and universities.

cards.title: Conceptual Clarity
cards.text: Intense curriculum rigor across mathematics and computer science.

cards.title: Board Mastery
cards.text: Continuous mocks, personalized feedback loops, and career counseling.

facilities.title: Sports & Physical Development
facilities.alt: Students in a yoga session on the school turf
facilities.text:
At The Indiranagar Cambridge School, we believe that sports are an important part of a child's overall development. Our students are encouraged to participate, stay active, build discipline and develop teamwork and sportsmanship.

Through regular physical activities, games and sports events, we help children develop fitness, confidence, resilience and a healthy competitive spirit.

facilities.title: Learning Through Discovery
facilities.alt: Students taking part in a hands-on activity with their teacher
facilities.text:
Our laboratories provide students with opportunities to move beyond textbooks and experience learning through observation, experimentation and practical activities.

By exploring concepts hands-on, students develop curiosity, scientific thinking, problem-solving skills and a deeper understanding of what they learn in the classroom.

facilities.title: Our Library
facilities.text:
Our library is a welcoming space where children can discover the joy of reading, explore new ideas and develop the habit of learning beyond the classroom.

Through books, stories and independent reading, we encourage our students to read, think, imagine and learn — building knowledge and curiosity one page at a time.

facilities.title: Reading Room
facilities.text: Designed with soundproof acoustic panels, soft ergonomics, and natural daylight orientation, our reading rooms are curated specifically for private contemplation, exam preparations, and independent creative writing. Free from digital noise, it fosters pure deep-work.

facilities.title: Multimedia
facilities.alt: A classroom with digital display boards
